facts.fact: 卫兵把全部俘虏拖出大殿，喊叫与抗议声充满空中。
facts.anchor: Clamoring, screams, and protests filled the air as the guards dragged all the captives away.

facts.fact: 她被卫兵抓住双臂拖走时高喊自己「有更好的主意」，并试图挣脱卫兵。
facts.anchor: “Wait!” I cried out, even as I tried to struggle away from the guards. “I have a better idea.”

facts.fact: 她向国王陈述：解决问题的第一步是找到问题的根源，并指其清除体系有缺陷、应查不忠的源头。
facts.anchor: “The first step in any problem-solving endeavor is finding the root of the problem,” I announced

facts.fact: 国王宣布要她留在此处、动用她心中的魔法，直到他完成铲除威胁的任务。
facts.anchor: You shall reside here until I have completed my mission.

facts.fact: 她以第二条条件要求国王带她渡过泪之河去寻找帽匠。
facts.anchor: You must take me across the River of Tears to search for the Hatter.

facts.fact: 国王只微微挥手，她身上的锁链便消散于空中。
facts.anchor: The king gave the slightest wave of his hand, and the chains around me dissolved into the ether.

facts.fact: 【人物关系】叙述者与国王是旧识——她曾认识的那个男人已彻底消失；如今他是高坐王座、囚她于殿上的暴君。
facts.anchor: My chest ached at the renewed realization that the man I once knew had been lost for good.

facts.fact: 【数字】女主角对国王说她愿意照办，但要提出「三项条件」（three conditions）——数目属于她与国王的这场谈判。
facts.anchor: “I will do as you say, under three conditions.”
